body_markdown:
How much of your day goes to looking for answers instead of acting on data?


While figuring out why usage is higher for a specific customer, whose invoice is overdue, and which customers up for renewal renew doesn’t exactly require any heavy lifting in Alguna, we decided to make it *even* easier for revenue teams to stay on top of their day-to-day.


**Una is the AI assistant built into Alguna.** You ask a question in plain English and get the answer in seconds, from your own revenue data.


When you want to get something done, Una AI guides you through it: it takes you to the right screen, fills in the details for you to check, and walks you through each step. Nothing changes until you review and confirm it.


Una AI works next to you in the dashboard and in Slack, and it already knows the customer, invoice, or contract you have on your screen.


Let’s take a look at how Una AI gets you the answers you need faster and helps you work smarter.


## How Una AI makes your day better


We built Una AI so your whole team can get answers and get work done faster, whether they're in Alguna all day or once a month.


**Una AI has the full context across customer accounts and every page or screen you’re on, but you’re always in control.**


In practice, this means *Una AI can only see and do what your own role in Alguna* *allows* . It never changes anything without showing you first and getting your approval, and every action it takes is recorded.


Type a question or a task in plain English, and Una AI answers it or completes the work.


Here's what that looks like day to day.


### Get answers in seconds, not hours


Ask about any customer, subscription, invoice, payment, quote, credit, or refund. Una AI reads your live data, so you get today's numbers, not last week's export. It can also check hundreds of records at once, for questions like "Which overdue invoices have a line item over $5,000?"


### Hand off the busywork


Ask Una AI to add a customer, draft an invoice, set up a product or plan, prepare a subscription change, issue a credit note or add prepaid credits. Before anything in your account changes, Una shows you exactly what it will do and waits for you to approve it. Pending actions also wait for you under Una AI → Approvals.


### Skip the explaining


Una AI sees the page you're on. Ask about "this invoice" or "these subscriptions" and it already knows which ones you mean. It can also fill in a form for you to review, or take you straight to the right screen.


### Learn Alguna as you go


Ask how anything in Alguna works and Una AI answers from our help docs, then helps you do it.


### Teach Una how your team works


Tell Una AI to remember something, such as a customer's preferred billing contact, and it will use it next time. Save a repeatable task as a skill (a saved set of instructions), then type / in chat to run it again.


### Let it work while you don't


Automations run Una AI on a schedule or when something happens in your account. For example, every Monday morning it can list overdue invoices and who to chase.


Set them up under **Una AI → Automations** .


### Interact with Una directly in Slack


Send Una AI a direct message or @mention Una in a channel to get an answer without opening Alguna.


The result: no more exporting to spreadsheets, no more waiting on someone else for a number, and no more clicking through screens to make a simple change.


## Top 3 use cases our customers love


These are the three jobs where Una saves the most time.


Each one used to mean an export, a spreadsheet or a message to another team.


### 1. Make billing changes in one sentence


Upgrades, one-off fees, prepaid credits and new customers each take several steps across different screens.


**Describe the billing change to Una AI in plain English and it finds the right customer** and subscription, prepares the change, and shows you exactly what will happen: what's changing, the amount and when it takes effect. It applies the change only when you click approve, and if you click deny, nothing changes.


Because every change waits for your approval, you can hand Una AI the routine edits and still decide exactly what reaches your customers' invoices.


Goodbye extra clicks.


****Try:**** **"Add a $500 credit to Acme's subscription for the outage on October 12."**


### 2. Get a 360° view of your customer’s revenue health


Before a renewal or check-in, you need the customer's plan, what they pay, any open invoices and recent changes. That usually means four tabs and a spreadsheet.


Ask Una AI and you get it all in one answer, taken from the same records Alguna bills from. Una brings together the customer's plan, their monthly and annual recurring revenue, open and overdue invoices, recent payments and their renewal date.


It also points out what needs your attention, such as an overdue invoice or a contract that won't renew on its own. If you're already on the customer's page in Alguna, you don't need to name them.


Just ask "Tell me about this account and flag anything I should act on."


****Try:**** **"Summarize Ramp for my call: their plan, MRR, open invoices, recent payments and renewal date."**


### 3. Get up to speed with overdue invoices


**Ask Una AI what's overdue and it lists every late invoice, who owes it and how many days late it is.**


It can also put them in order for you, oldest and largest first, and suggest who to chase first. When you're ready to follow up, ask Una AI to draft a payment reminder for you to send.


When a customer tells you they've paid, tell Una AI and it marks the invoice as paid once you approve.


No more ageing reports, and no more matching payments to invoices by hand.


****Try:**** **"Summarize my overdue invoices by customer, oldest and largest first, and suggest who to chase first."**

## Get started in five minutes


There is nothing to install. Una is already in your Alguna account.


1. **Open Una AI.** Log in to Alguna and click **Ask Una AI** at the top of any page, or choose **Una AI** in the main menu for a full-screen chat.
2. **Ask your first question.** Pick a prompt from the list above, or type your own in plain English.
3. **Approve what it proposes.** When you ask Una to change something, it shows you the change first. Click approve to apply it, or deny to leave everything as it is.
4. **Save what you repeat.** Turn a task you do every week into a skill or an automation, so it runs with one click or on its own.
5. **Bring Una into Slack.** Connect Slack under **Settings → Integrations** , then send Una a direct message or @mention it in a channel.


## Try Una AI today


The questions that used to take an afternoon now take a sentence. Una gives you the answer from your live data, does the routine work for you, and checks with you before changing anything.
